Average replicate measurements of D47

Source: R/avg.replicates.R
avg.replicates.Rd

Averages the D47 replicates of each sample and returns the standard error of each mean. The result can be used as a calibration or reconstruction dataset.

Usage

avg.replicates(data, pooledSD = NULL)

Arguments

data

A data.frame with one row per replicate and the columns Sample and D47.

pooledSD

Optional SD used for every sample instead of the SD of its own replicates, such as the long-term SD of standards measured in the same lab.

Value

A data.frame with one row per sample and the columns Sample, D47 (mean), D47sd (SD of the replicates), N (number of replicates), and D47error (standard error of the mean), followed by the columns that were kept.

Details

D47error is the standard error of the mean, SD / sqrt(N). By default, the SD comes from the replicates of each sample. Samples with a single replicate then have no SE, so a warning is given. Other columns are kept when they have a single value within every sample, such as Material or Temperature.

Examples

reps <- data.frame(
  Sample = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 3),
  D47 = c(0.601, 0.598, 0.605, 0.702, 0.695, 0.699),
  Material = "calcite"
)
avg.replicates(reps)
#>   Sample       D47       D47sd N    D47error Material
#> 1      A 0.6013333 0.003511885 3 0.002027588  calcite
#> 2      B 0.6986667 0.003511885 3 0.002027588  calcite
avg.replicates(reps, pooledSD = 0.008)
#>   Sample       D47       D47sd N    D47error Material
#> 1      A 0.6013333 0.003511885 3 0.004618802  calcite
#> 2      B 0.6986667 0.003511885 3 0.004618802  calcite
